body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveiled its 14.1-inch Santa Rosa-based notebook pc ‘Sense X22’ during KES 2007, which adopts ATI Radeon HD 2400 card. Measuring 28.2~38.8mm thickness and 2.18kg weight, the Sense X22 supports HSDPA/WiBro, HDMI port and multi memory card slot. With metal brown color, it is expected to be released in Korea market in November. Suggested price is between 1,800,000(KRW) and 1,900,000(KRW).
